strategies.name: 5m_opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle. Then on the 1-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap; after price retests the fair value gap, enter when the retest candle gets engulfed in the breakout direction.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop just beyond the deepest point traded into the fair value gap, with one tick of breathing room. Take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk and otherwise do not micromanage the trade.

strategies.name: 15m_opening_range_fvg_limit_entry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle. Then on the 5-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels and form a fair value gap; instead of waiting for a retest confirmation candle, place a limit order at the fair value gap so entry occurs automatically
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop at/beyond the first candle of the fair value gap pattern. Take profit at a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk and otherwise let the trade play out without micromanaging.

enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct entry skeletons: a scalping FVG retest with engulfing confirmation and 3:1 target, and a day-trading FVG limit-entry approach with 2:1 target.
